label: Run Java File
args: echo "=== ZED TASK DEBUG ===" && echo "PWD: $(pwd)" && echo "ZED_FILE: $ZED_FILE" && echo "ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT: $ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT" && cd "$(dirname "$ZED_FILE")" && echo "NEW PWD: $(pwd)" && echo "CLASSPATH: $ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/src:..:." && echo "======================" && java -cp "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/src:..:." "$ZED_FILE"

label: Run Java File with Preview
args: echo "=== ZED TASK DEBUG ===" && echo "PWD: $(pwd)" && echo "ZED_FILE: $ZED_FILE" && echo "ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT: $ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT" && cd "$(dirname "$ZED_FILE")" && echo "NEW PWD: $(pwd)" && echo "CLASSPATH: $ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/src:..:." && echo "======================" && java --enable-preview --source 21 -cp "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/src:..:." "$ZED_FILE"
